sloka: उत्तिष्ठत प्रबुध्यध्वं भद्रमस्तु च व: सदा ।नाव: समनुकर्षध्वं तारयिष्याम वाहिनीम् ।। २.८९.९ ।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭhata prabudhyadhvaṁ bhadramastu ca va: sadā ।nāva: samanukarṣadhvaṁ tārayiṣyāma vāhinīm ।। 2.89.9 ।।

translations.english: Arise and awake. May you be ever blessed. Haul down the boats into the river. We have to ferry the army (across the river).
